The '''Galactic Zoo''' was an attraction on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], advertised by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency as a part of their [[Trek to Tatooine]] tour of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Galactic Zoo was mentioned in the Trek to Tatooine "commercial" played on the large video screen in the queue of the original version of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube queue video">{{YouTube|video=f7a91G8k9Nk|text=Trek To Tatooine|channel=channel/UCVsNHJYZ3Nf4YUnlhiK6NMQ|name=WDWScottsmitty}}</ref>
